title: Book Club Chat
summary: The group met to discuss the novel they were reading. Anita asked if everyone had finished, and Vikram said he had read most of it but found the first half slow. Zoya praised the ending and the twist involving the lighthouse keeper. Anita noted the narrator seemed unreliable, and Vikram said he was still considering that aspect. Zoya compared the pacing to the author's earlier book, and the meeting concluded with a positive note on the discussion.
discussion_points: Anita asked if everyone finished the novel
Vikram had read most of the book but found the first half dragged
Zoya loved the ending and the lighthouse keeper twist
Anita thought the narrator was unreliable from the start
Vikram was still thinking about the narrator issue
Zoya felt the author's earlier book had better pacing
